compound noun denoting a supreme mantra or sacred knowledge

items.question: What form of great knowledge is identified as the twenty-one-syllabled great goddess beginning with praṇava?
premises: A great knowledge is described as twenty-one-syllabled.
This great knowledge begins with praṇava.
This great knowledge is identified as the great goddess.
items.inference: The twenty-one-syllabled great knowledge beginning with praṇava is the great goddess.
uncertainties: The specific mantra corresponding to this twenty-one-syllabled form is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: The great knowledge of twenty-one syllables, beginning with praṇava, is the great goddess.
